verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. LORD, you’ve searched me through and through. You know me.
You know when I sit and when I get up. You catch my thoughts from far away.
You see where I go and where I lie down. You know every move I make.
Before a word even reaches my tongue, LORD, you already know the whole thing.
You surround me, behind and ahead, and rest your hand on me.
That kind of knowledge is beyond me. It’s too high for me to reach.
Where could I go to get away from your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?
If I climb into heaven, you’re there. If I make my bed in Sheol, look, you’re there too!
If I ride on the wings of dawn and settle at the far edge of the sea,
even there your hand will guide me, and your right hand will hold on to me.
If I say, “The dark will swallow me up for sure. The light around me will turn to night,”
even darkness can’t hide anything from you. Night shines like day. Darkness and light are the same to you.
You shaped the deepest parts of me. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
I thank you because the way you made me fills me with awe and wonder. What you make is wonderful. Deep down, I know it.
You saw my frame when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
You saw my body before it was finished. Every day you’d planned for me was written in your book before a single one had begun.
God, your thoughts are precious to me! There are so many of them.
If I tried to count them, there’d be more than grains of sand. When I wake up, I’m still with you.
God, if only you’d do away with the wicked! Get away from me, you bloodthirsty people!
They speak against you with evil intent. Your enemies use your name as if it means nothing.
LORD, don’t I hate the ones who hate you? Doesn’t it grieve me when people rise against you?
I hate them completely. They’ve made themselves my enemies.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Put me to the test and know my thoughts.
See if there’s any evil path in me, and lead me in the way that lasts forever.
